description: Before quoting a page in an answer, checks that each quote or value occurs in the capture’s Markdown as written, with no browser and no model. The Markdown’s own markup (escapes, emphasis, link syntax, list and quote prefixes) is undone and line wrapping ignored; a quote never runs across two blocks, and a word or number has to stand apart (4.99 is not in 14.99). Each quote comes back with the line and the section it is under, or, when missing, where the capture parts from it, to correct it by. A match only once curly quotes, dashes and case are folded is reported as "loose" and does not count as found unless loose is set. "allFound" says whether every quote is there.

loose.description: Accept a quote that matches only once curly quotes, dashes, the ellipsis and case are folded. Off by default: a quote should be the page’s words.

markdown.description: The capture’s Markdown as text, as scan_page returns it with markdown "inline". Give this or path.

path.description: The capture’s Markdown file: the .md scan_page wrote with markdown "beside" or "only". Give this or markdown.

quotes.description: The quotes and values to look for, each as it will appear in the answer: a sentence, a price, a date, a name.

name: check_quotes
title: Check quotes against a capture
